_note: Menu data layer per SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md. One row per dish. Feeds /menu/, the home teaser, and Menu schema. CLAUDE.md is explicit: menu items, descriptions, and prices are NEVER generated or modified without client approval.
_status: INCOMPLETE AND NOT LAUNCH-READY. This file holds only the ten dishes confirmed in CLIENT_FACTS.md, at brand-level prices. It is NOT the per-location menu. SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md Open Decision #12: we do not know what each location actually serves, Toast is the seed source, and /menu/ cannot ship until that pull happens.
_availabilityStatus: SEEDED 2026-08-04 from all seven live Toast catalogs. Open Decision #12 closes. Every row's `locations` is derived by exact name match against src/_data/toastMenus/*.json through an explicit alias table, because three separate substring matchers on this project produced wrong answers. TWO ALIASES ARE NAME CONFLICTS, not typos, and are flagged in _nameConflicts below.
_descriptionStatus: DRAFT, PENDING CLIENT APPROVAL. Descriptions are ingredient lists carried over from the design concept, with unconfirmed claims removed (the concept's 'simmered twelve hours' has no source in CLIENT_FACTS.md and is not repeated here). No description asserts anything about flour, hydration, water, alkalinity, aging, or noodle cadence. Amanda must sign these off before launch.
_priceStatus: STALE AS OF 2026-08-04, and now measurably so. Nine of the thirteen brand prices are below live Convoy: every ramen is $0.50 under except Miso Ramen, which is $0.50 OVER at 18.50 against a live 18.00. The four appetiser and dessert prices match Convoy exactly. Prices also vary by location: Plaza Bonita runs $2.00 below the other San Diego rooms and Maui runs $2.50 to $3.50 above them, so a single brand price cannot be right for all seven. No `offers` are emitted in schema and none should be until someone decides whether /menu/ prints Convoy's prices, a range, or none.
_carnitasNote: RESOLVED 2026-08-04, SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md Open Decision #4. Confirmed active at all seven locations via live Toast menus. Present here on purpose: listed plainly on /menu/ with feature: false, and nowhere else. No photo, no card, no callout, no hero, no fusion framing anywhere on the site. DO NOT DELETE IT AS A VIOLATION: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and voice-tone.md still carry blanket bans that predate this decision and have not been edited yet (Open Decision #21). Those docs are stale on this one point; this row is correct.

_nameConflicts: menu.json's names do NOT match what Toast calls two of these dishes. Recorded rather than changed, because renaming a menu item is a client decision. (1) `Tajima White` is called `Tajima Ramen` on all six San Diego catalogs and `Tajima WHITE Ramen` on Maui. So the San Diego menu has no item literally called Tajima White, and the site currently prints one. (2) `Miso Ramen` is called `Naruto Miso Ramen` everywhere it appears, and the description names a Naruto fishcake that menu.json does not mention.
